findings.title: The freeze branch persisted an UNDELIVERED 'escalated' outcome, so a multi-party message with an ambiguous counterparty and a frozen fileable sibling never escalated - and escalated_for() then treated it as delivered forever
findings.evidence: Fixed in 594327f2 / efc90b57: _demote_undelivered_escalations() runs before the frozen row and before the G-BUDGET-2 row. Re-verified by probe H (frozen: 0 sends, no persisted 'escalated'; --retry-frozen + good result: exactly 1 send; later sweep: 0 sends, no new row), probe BUD (budget row demoted; next run 1 send with 0 LLM calls; then 0), probe ESC (only-escalated message never reaches the branch; 1 send then silent) and probe DRY (dry-run keeps 'escalated' on the simulated row; the live retry still pages once). Pinned by test_an_ambiguous_counterparty_on_a_frozen_message_is_still_paged_once + G-ESC-5 (sed bites). Nothing the demotion touches changed esc_state['already'] semantics: it is derived from persisted 'escalated' outcomes only, which the demoted rows no longer carry.

summary: F-5 and F-6 are fixed and re-verified on efc90b57 by five probes: the digest now carries a still-frozen identity from the receipt on later days (one line on the day of the freeze, no OK collapse two days later, cleared after --retry-frozen succeeds); an ambiguous counterparty on a frozen or budget-halted message is demoted, never persisted as delivered, and paged exactly once by the run that gets past extraction; only-escalated messages and dry-run rows behave as before. Both new guards (G-DIG-5, G-ESC-5) are registered with seds that bite and their pinning tests exist. F-1/F-2 remain fixed-and-reverified (F-2 re-probed on this tree), F-3 confirmed-code-kept, F-4 carried as the activate-goal watch item. No new findings; zero open.
